title: Blender warranty claim
ask: Olivia Mensah's Brightwell blender stopped working 11 months after she bought it (claim BW-3350). Her email is in inbox/customer.txt. It is covered, so write the reply that starts the claim and send it.
background: It is the 1200 watt model and the motor has gone, which we have seen before.
Repairs take about a week once the blender reaches the workshop.
She mentioned she uses it daily for her kids' breakfasts.

constraints.text: tell her to post it within a stated number of days, 14 at most
make the first line exactly "Subject: Your warranty claim BW-3350"
ask her for proof of purchase

start.inbox/customer.txt:
From: olivia.mensah@customer.example
Subject: Blender dead after 11 months

My blender will not turn on any more. It is under a year old. What do I do?

Olivia
